verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of subtask creation or dependency/blocking-order linking features (all docs items focus on AI agents, MCP, and integrations). The only relevant evidence is a community complaint that 'linking tickets to one another in Monday is really bad, data gets lost all the time' (monday-comm-4), which is negative rather than confirmatory, and there is no vendor claim in this pack to set up a dispute.
